name: user-simulation
description: Run synthetic users over a live web app and get step-by-step UX reports (action, clarity, doubt, emotion). Two modes: run (a single run, more manual control — your profile, URL and task) and autopilot (an automatic multi-user run, less manual control — just a URL, it proposes users for you to curate, runs them all and consolidates). Drives the browser via Playwright MCP.
